summary: All scenarios for the Herdr container detection fix passed live validation. The fix correctly handles HERDR_SOCKET_PATH fallback detection when HERDR_ENV=1 is not available (the container case), while preserving existing precedence and all non-breaking behavior. 21 backend detection unit tests pass, including a new comprehensive 8-case test for HERDR_SOCKET_PATH detection.
tested: bash tests/fm-backend.test.sh (21 passing backend detection tests)
test_backend_detect_precedence: All existing detection combinations (6 nested cases) ✓
testing_summary: Exercised all 7 required scenarios for HERDR_SOCKET_PATH fallback detection via live unit tests with real Unix domain sockets: valid socket detection for containers (primary use case), strict rejection of non-sockets and missing files, boundary handling of empty values, correct precedence preservation (HERDR_ENV > HERDR_SOCKET_PATH, TMUX > both), and test isolation fixes to prevent environment bleed. All 21 backend detection tests pass, including new and existing coverage.

scenarios.name: Valid socket detection: HERDR_SOCKET_PATH pointing to real Unix domain socket detects herdr backend when HERDR_ENV is not set
scenarios.reason: Created real Unix socket via Python3, called fm_backend_detect() with isolated environment, verified return value = herdr and FM_BACKEND_DETECT_SIGNAL=HERDR_SOCKET_PATH

scenarios.name: Non-socket file guard: Regular files (non-sockets) are strictly rejected and do not trigger herdr detection
scenarios.reason: Created regular file with touch, set HERDR_SOCKET_PATH to file path, verified fm_backend_detect() returns 1 (undetected)

scenarios.name: Missing file guard: Non-existent paths are strictly rejected and do not trigger herdr detection
scenarios.reason: Set HERDR_SOCKET_PATH to /path/to/nonexistent.sock, verified fm_backend_detect() returns 1 (undetected)

scenarios.name: Boundary handling: Empty and unset HERDR_SOCKET_PATH values do not trigger herdr detection
scenarios.reason: Tested with HERDR_SOCKET_PATH="" (empty) and completely unset, both returned 1 (undetected) from fm_backend_detect()

scenarios.name: HERDR_ENV precedence: When both HERDR_ENV=1 and HERDR_SOCKET_PATH (socket) are set, HERDR_ENV wins and detection signal is HERDR_ENV
scenarios.reason: Set both HERDR_ENV=1 and HERDR_SOCKET_PATH to valid socket, verified fm_backend_detect() returns herdr with FM_BACKEND_DETECT_SIGNAL=HERDR_ENV (not HERDR_SOCKET_PATH)

scenarios.name: TMUX innermost-first precedence: When both TMUX and HERDR_SOCKET_PATH (socket) are set, TMUX wins for correct nesting resolution
scenarios.reason: Set both TMUX and HERDR_SOCKET_PATH to valid socket with HERDR_ENV unset, verified fm_backend_detect() returns tmux with FM_BACKEND_DETECT_SIGNAL=TMUX

scenarios.name: Container primary use case: Container-spawned Herdr agents without HERDR_ENV=1 but with forwarded HERDR_SOCKET_PATH correctly detect herdr backend
scenarios.reason: Created container-like environment (HERDR_ENV unset, HERDR_SOCKET_PATH=valid socket, TMUX unset), verified herdr detection works end-to-end

scenarios.name: All existing backend detection scenarios remain unchanged and pass: precedence order, nesting resolution, and backward compatibility maintained
scenarios.evidence: bash tests/fm-backend.test.sh: All 21 backend detection tests, 20 existing + 1 new
scenarios.reason: Ran full test suite; all 6 existing precedence cases, 4 existing nesting cases, and 10 other backend tests pass without modification
